newsitem.title: HONG KONG: H&S Hotels to buy California resort.
newsitem.headline: H&S Hotels to buy California resort.

text.p: Hongkong and Shanghai Hotels Ltd (HSH) said on Thursday it had signed a memorandum of understanding to purchase Quail Lodge Inc, owner of a resort and housing development in California.

Quil Lodge owns Quail Lodge Resort & Golf Club, an 850-acre complex in the Carmel Valley including a golf course and 100 rooms and suites, and Quail Meadows, a 614-acre site subdivided into 56 residential lots.

"The Quail Lodge Resort & Golf Club will be the perfect complement for our two city-based hotels in the United States, the Peninsula New York and the Peninsula Beverly Hills," HSH chairman Michael Kadoorie said in a statement.
The formal sale and purchase agreement will be signed following a period of due diligence.
